clue.text: Obsession about receptacles for rubbish

indicators.note: about signals turning round, so the word for obsession is read backwards

parts.note: a bug is a craze or obsession (the travel bug)
bins are receptacles for waste

explanation.surface: Someone fixated on dustbins and what goes in them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rubbish' looks like part of the bins' description, but it is the definition; 'about' turns the obsession word round.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal British synonym: gubbins means odds and ends, worthless stuff or nonsense.

clue.text: Hollywood star throwing out old dress

indicators.note: throwing out tells us a letter is discarded from the star's name

parts.note: Greta Garbo, the Swedish-born Hollywood screen star

explanation.surface: A film star discarding an old frock.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: garb is clothing or attire, as a noun meaning dress.

clue.text: Sob loudly, confronted with fat

definitions.meaning: the thick fat layer of whales and seals

explanation.surface: Someone crying hard when told they are overweight.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a verb for noisy weeping, and the noun for whale fat.

clue.text: Singers give one a lift, producing this divine stuff

indicators.note: one is the letter I, and in a down entry giving it a lift moves it higher, to the top

parts.note: a choir is a group of singers

explanation.surface: A choir hoisting someone up, producing something heavenly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'give one a lift' takes the I (one) of CHOIR and raises it to the top of the down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth, ichor is the ethereal fluid flowing in the veins of the gods instead of blood.

clue.text: Start to scatter herb (the Spanish, not the French) thinly

indicators.note: start to indicates the first letter of the next word
X not Y means put X where Y was, swapping one article for the other

parts.note: parsley is a common herb
le is French for the
el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: A recipe telling you to scatter herb sparingly, with a linguistic aside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' signals a swap: the Spanish article replaces the French one inside the herb, giving PARSELY.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: done sparsely means spread thinly, with little density.

clue.text: Giant gun finally replaced by British gang member

indicators.note: replaced by says one letter gives way to another

parts.note: a monster is something giant

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of gun

explanation.surface: A huge gun swapped out for a British gangster.
explanation.walkthrough: In MONSTER the N (gun finally) is replaced by B.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a mobster is a member of a criminal gang or mob.

clue.text: Carry weight and substance

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a verb for being significant and a noun for physical material.

clue.text: Causing harassment? Yours truly often will

definitions.meaning: ... describes something that constantly troubles, as a ... sin
yours truly is the setter of the crossword, who will often be busy compiling clues

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition splits the answer as BE SETTING: the setter (yours truly) often will be setting a puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: an adjective for persistent trouble, and a phrase for compiling puzzles.

clue.text: Eg sergeant-major and son dipping into big book

definitions.text: Eg sergeant-major and son dipping into big book

indicators.note: dipping into puts the officer and son inside the book

parts.note: a tome is a large heavy volume
a sergeant-major is a warrant officer, abbreviated WO

explanation.surface: A soldier and his boy browsing a weighty volume together.
explanation.walkthrough: A sergeant-major is a warrant officer in the British army. The whole clue also pictures a pair reading together.
explanation.definitionFit: A pair of people together, like a soldier and his boy, form a couple or duo.

clue.text: Get better and newly assess English award received

indicators.note: received means the prize and abbreviation are taken inside

parts.note: re- is a prefix meaning anew or again
to rate is to assess or evaluate
a cup is a trophy awarded

explanation.surface: Someone recovering from illness, reassessing an English prize.
explanation.walkthrough: 'newly' gives the prefix RE, and 'received' places the award and English inside the rated word.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to recuperate is to recover health after illness.

clue.text: Disorderly players getting plastered?

parts.note: rough means unruly or disorderly
the cast is the set of players in a show

explanation.surface: Rowdy actors getting drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plastered' suggests drunkenness, but it means coated with plaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Roughcast is a coarse plaster with gravel, and as a verb to roughcast a wall is to coat it so.

clue.text: Zeno, say, thus digesting books from the East

indicators.note: digesting means swallowing the books inside

parts.note: sic is Latin for thus

indicators.note: from the East means read right to left, backwards in an across entry

parts.note: OT, the Old Testament, is a set of books

explanation.surface: A philosopher eating up Eastern texts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from the East' reverses the books abbreviation (in an across entry, East-to-West is right to left), giving TO.
explanation.definitionFit: Zeno of Citium founded Stoicism, so he is an example of that school's philosopher.

clue.text: Swift action is needed to make this course possible

definitions.text: Swift action is needed to make this course possible

parts.words: Swift action is needed to make this course possible
parts.note: the swift is a bird whose nest-building supplies the delicacy, and the course is a dish in a meal

explanation.surface: A prompt act is required to make a plan feasible.
explanation.walkthrough: Swiftlets build nests of saliva, which are made into a Chinese soup; 'Swift' is the bird and 'course' is part of a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A Chinese delicacy served as a course, made from edible nests of swiftlets.

clue.text: Barely sufficient funds for securing a trainer?

definitions.meaning: a lace ties up a sports shoe, called a trainer in Britain

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a meagre budget, and the literal lace that ties up a shoe.

clue.text: Expression of surprise about telephone man's bloomer

parts.note: ha is an exclamation of surprise
re means about, concerning
Alexander Graham Bell, inventor of the telephone

explanation.surface: Someone exclaiming at a phone engineer's blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' looks like a blunder but means a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A harebell is a wild flower with blue bell-shaped blooms, so it is a plant that blooms.

clue.text: Brainy chap with temperature nursing ailment

indicators.note: nursing means holding the ailment inside the name

parts.note: Brian is a man's name, a chap
an ill is an ailment

explanation.surface: A clever man with a fever, tending a sickness.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: brilliant means exceptionally clever.

clue.text: Long and narrow area skirted by cruise ship

indicators.note: skirted by means surrounded on the outside by the ship

parts.note: a liner is a large passenger ship

explanation.surface: A slim stretch of water bordered by a cruising vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Linear means arranged in a line, so elongated and slim in shape.

clue.text: Like the dire publications Penny once bought?

definitions.text: Like the dire publications Penny once bought?

parts.words: Like the dire publications Penny once bought?
parts.note: penny ... were cheap sensational Victorian serials, costing a penny; Penny looks like a woman's name

explanation.walkthrough: Penny dreadfuls were lurid 19th-century British fiction sold for a penny; 'Penny' poses as a girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means dire or awful, and names those cheap Victorian thrillers.

clue.text: Late in reforming legal restriction

indicators.note: reforming means the letters are shaped into a new order

explanation.surface: A tardy reform of a legal rule.
explanation.definitionFit: An entail is a legal settlement restricting inheritance of property to a line of heirs.

clue.text: But is it manipulated solely by the seamstress?

definitions.text: But is it manipulated solely by the seamstress?

parts.words: But is it manipulated solely by the seamstress?
parts.note: solely hints at the sole of the foot, which works the pedal of a sewing machine

explanation.walkthrough: 'solely' seems to mean 'only' but points to the sole of the foot.
explanation.definitionFit: A foot-operated pedal that drives an old sewing machine or wheel.

clue.text: In father's mine, pass over floating foam

indicators.note: in means the turned word sits inside father's

parts.note: FR is the abbreviation for father, plus the possessive S

indicators.note: over signals turning the word for pass backwards

parts.note: to go is to pass, as in taking a turn
a pit is a coal mine

explanation.surface: An instruction about a father's colliery and a passing manoeuvre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns the pass word round to OG, which sits inside the possessive father abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Frogspit is the frothy cuckoo-spit, or a floating scum of algae on ponds.

clue.text: Requirement for shield to be left unfinished

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: left unfinished means the last letter is removed

parts.note: a visor shields the face or eyes

explanation.surface: A demand that a shield should not be completed.
explanation.walkthrough: VISOR loses its final R ('left unfinished').
explanation.definitionFit: A proviso is a condition or stipulation attached to an agreement.

clue.text: Reason for carrying ruler on river boat?

indicators.note: carrying means holding the ruler and river inside

parts.note: why is the reason for something
ER, Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: Why a monarch is on a river boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A wherry is a light rowing boat or barge used on rivers.

clue.text: The sack elderly folk ultimately use in own house

parts.note: the old are elderly people

indicators.note: in means the letter goes inside the word for own

parts.note: to have is to own

indicators.note: ultimately takes the last letter of use

explanation.surface: Old people being fired but staying in their own home.
explanation.walkthrough: E (use ultimately) goes in HAVE to make HEAVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: getting this means being dismissed from a job, like getting the sack.

clue.text: Inside of limo speeding over the Derby area

indicators.note: over in a down entry signals reading upwards, backwards
inside of tells us the letters sit within the words limo speeding

explanation.surface: A limousine racing past the Derby district.
explanation.walkthrough: MOSPE sits inside 'limo speeding' and 'over' turns it round. Derby looks like the English city but is the horse race.
explanation.definitionFit: The Derby is the famous flat horse race run at that Surrey racecourse town.

clue.text: About to suffer no end providing intelligence

indicators.note: no end means the final letter is dropped

parts.note: in for means due to face, as in in for a shock

explanation.surface: Something about to suffer endlessly, giving information.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal abbreviation: information or intelligence, as in gathered facts.

clue.text: Sodium extracted from Jones's place in Asian country

indicators.note: extracted from means the element's symbol is taken out

parts.note: Indiana Jones, the film adventurer, has a US state for a first name
Na is the chemical symbol for sodium

explanation.surface: Salt removed from a man's home in Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jones's place' is the first name in Indiana Jones, which is also a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: A nation of South Asia, the world's most populous country.

clue.text: Alter design of iron safe unhappily containing heroin

indicators.note: containing means the drug's letter sits inside
unhappily means the letters are put into disorder

parts.note: H is slang for heroin

explanation.surface: Redesigning a safe that hides drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unhappily' rearranges the eight fodder letters into REFASION, and 'containing' wraps it round H.
explanation.definitionFit: To give something a new form or style is to remake its design.

clue.text: Very much at large in drab clothing

indicators.note: clothing means the colour wraps around

parts.note: grey means drab, dull

explanation.surface: A fugitive wearing dull clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: greatly means to a large degree, considerably.

clue.text: Walk unsteadily to work over river

parts.note: to limp is to walk unevenly
op is an opus, a work
O is over in cricket scoring

explanation.surface: Hobbling to the office across a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Limpopo is a major river of southern Africa, flowing into the Indian Ocean.
